verdict.rationale: iTerm2 is a locally installed macOS terminal with its source in a public GitHub repo (gnachman/iTerm2), so the core product runs entirely on the user's own machine. Its session server processes are also local, and the generative AI features ship as an optional plugin rather than a required cloud service. missing for 10: explicit license/open-source terms in the evidence, documented build-from-source instructions, and a way to point the AI features at a self-hosted/local model instead of OpenAI.
